readme_excerpt: Consul Consul is a distributed, highly available, and data center aware solution to connect and configure applications across dynamic, distributed infrastructure. Documentation and Tutorials: [https://developer.hashicorp.com/consul] Forum: Discuss Consul provides several key features: Multi-Datacenter - Consul is built to be datacenter aware, and can support any number of regions without complex configuration.
